_comment_setup: Run 'python3 src/voice_pipeline.py setup' to generate this file interactively.
_comment_folders_lite: Lite mode (default): watch folder in ~/Documents, no Full Disk Access needed.
_comment_folders_full: Full mode (local-first): watch folder in iCloud Drive — swap paths below.

transcription._comment_lite: Lite mode: OpenAI Whisper API — no local deps, requires api_key below.
transcription._comment_full: Full mode (local-first): uncomment below and comment out backend above.

_comment_lanes: Optional. Define workflow lanes in config.json (not here). Speak the lane name at the start of a recording to route it. See README for the full schema.

gpt_handoff.instructions: Continue the active conversation using the transcript as source of truth. Answer the user's latest question first, then add any useful follow-up or clarifying questions.
